versions.description_html:
AI answers get better when it understands the context of your factory. In this episode of the iFAKT series, we discuss knowledge graphs: modeling equipment, processes and relationships, and linking them to AI.
You will learn how a graph can give AI the context it needs.
Who it is for: Data architects, AI teams and manufacturing engineers.
